title: Bone-Of-undying
description: This texture pack changes the totem of undying into the texture of a bone, this idea came from a meme between friends. The bone that will be displayed is the minecraft bone item.
body: When using this texture pack it changes the totem of undying texture into the minecraft bone item. You may want to download this as having a bone as totem of undying can be fun. This is specificaly made for 1.21.1 and you probably will encounter problems with different versions.![What your ToU will look like](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c436b52673e28654b53826174612ecf1c9d08086.png)
